question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Innate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inherent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Innate **means belonging to or determined by factors present in an individual from birth. (जन्म से एक व्यक्ति में मौजूद कारकों द्वारा निर्धारित)

 
 
• Example -* Cyril's most impressive quality was his **innate **goodness.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Inherent **means existing as a natural and permanent quality of something or someone. (किसी चीज या किसी के प्राकृतिक और स्थायी गुण के रूप में विद्यमान)
 
 
• Example -* The drug has certain **inherent **side effects.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Innate**' and '**Inherent**' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Learnt **means to get knowledge or skill from somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से ज्ञान, कौशल आदि प्राप्‍त करना, सीखना)
 
• **Inured **means to accustom to accept something undesirable. (किसी अवांछित बात को स्वीकार करने का आदी होना)
 
• **Inane **means extremely silly or lacking real meaning or importance. (अत्यंत मूर्खतापूर्ण या वास्तविक अर्थ या महत्व का अभाव)
